_help: Settings shared by every page of this project. Each page has its own file next to this one (index.json, product.json, checkout.json, thank-you.json). Keys ending in _html may contain HTML; {placeholders} are filled in by the page. See projects/README.md.

theme._help: Colors override the defaults in assets/css/common.css. Add or change any --variable used by the CSS (write it without the leading --).

_products_help: How each API product is shown. The key is matched against the API product name (case-insensitive). The product NAME, prices and plans always come from the funnel JSON; this only adds image, tagline, badge and featured.

tirzepatide & tesamorelin._note: Membership bundle (membership_campaign_set). Copy/image are placeholders — see NOTES-OPEN-ITEMS.md.
tirzepatide & tesamorelin.tagline: Stronger appetite control. Preferred for faster weight loss.

semaglutide & tesamorelin._note: Membership bundle (membership_campaign_set). Copy/image are placeholders — see NOTES-OPEN-ITEMS.md.

_bonus_help: Free add-on shown on the product and checkout pages. Set to null to hide it everywhere. Its image is only shown for products whose funnel JSON name contains match (e.g. NAD).

bonus.name: NAD+
bonus.line: with every plan — both products, one low price.
bonus.text: Your GLP-1 and your NAD+ ship together. Both products, one low price — nothing to add on.

_included_help: "Your plan, all in" list on the product cards and checkout. value = crossed-out price.
